name: New Ulm 2024

information: ## The competition is cancelled due to weather. All competitors have been fully refunded. Please check your emails for more information. Welcome to the first competition in Southwest, Minnesota! We will be doing check-in both in the morning and afternoon. Most competitors will be competing after lunch, but we will still host a new competitor tutorial in the morning for those participating in the morning events. Morning events: 6x6, 7x7, Square-1 Afternoon events: 3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Skewb | | | -------- | This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWxjIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d1f52348f9e8749067367295f2008944d5ecb8df/image.png) We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
